topBearNews.summary: The memory-shortage thesis assumes AI usage and memory demand rise together. DeepSeek just supplied a reason that relationship may be weaker. Its September 10 release says V4.1-Flash needs one-quarter as much HBM and one-eighth as much SSD capacity for its KV cache as the previous generation. That matters to Micron Technology, Inc.
